CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vip_contracts (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  contract_number VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  customer_id INT NULL,
  customer_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  customer_email VARCHAR(255) NULL,
  customer_phone VARCHAR(50) NULL,
  customer_address TEXT NULL,
  vehicle_description VARCHAR(255) NULL,
  city VARCHAR(100) NULL,
  start_date DATE NOT NULL,
  end_date DATE NOT NULL,
  total_price DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL,
  status ENUM('pending_signature','active','expired','cancelled') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending_signature',
  signature_token VARCHAR(128) NULL UNIQUE,
  signed_at DATETIME NULL,
  client_signature_data LONGTEXT NULL,
  rep_name VARCHAR(255) NULL,
  renewal_notified TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  notes TEXT NULL,
  created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vip_visits (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  contract_id INT NOT NULL,
  visit_number INT NOT NULL,
  scheduled_date DATE NULL,
  scheduled_time VARCHAR(10) NULL,
  job_id VARCHAR(100) NULL,
  status ENUM('scheduled','completed','missed','cancelled') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'scheduled',
  add_ons JSON NULL,
  notes TEXT NULL,
  completed_at DATETIME NULL,
  created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  FOREIGN KEY (contract_id) REFERENCES vip_contracts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  UNIQUE KEY uq_contract_visit (contract_id, visit_number)
);
